assertions.description: Output uses git log or checks modification dates to determine when files were last updated
assertions.evidence: Phase 1 table: 'git log --format="%ad" --date=short -1 -- <file>' method declared. All 39 files have 'Последнее обновление' dates from git.

assertions.description: Output identifies at least one specific file as potentially stale based on modification date or commit history
assertions.evidence: 9 files flagged CONTENT-STALE: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/MANUAL_TESTS.md, docs/USER_GUIDE_admin.md, docs/USER_GUIDE_owner.md, docs/USER_GUIDE_staff.md, docs/DEPLOY.md, docs/IMPROVEMENT_MASTER_PLAN.md, docs/COMMAND_AUDIT.md, docs/COMMAND_AUDIT_ADMIN.md.

assertions.description: Output assigns AP-XX codes to freshness-related antipatterns (e.g. AP-XX for stale documentation)
assertions.evidence: Phase 2 lists 14 AP-F0X violations: AP-F01 (time-stale), AP-F02 (version drift), AP-F03 (stale status), AP-F04 (code-doc drift) applied to specific files.

assertions.description: Output provides a Verification Score in N/5 format for documentation freshness
assertions.evidence: Header: 'Verification Score: 2/5'. Footer: 'VERIFICATION SCORE: 2/5' with criteria table (5 criteria, 1 pass, 4 fail).
